note: Retrieval catalog for the Interaction Trigger Policy. Looking up a rule or running context-escape must not create or rewrite Interaction records. Retrieval applies symmetrically to internal and external sources.
write_policy: retrieve broadly, write conservatively, additive versioned history
history_policy: When a write is justified, append or version; do not destructively overwrite prior rule states.

rules.title: Detecting a missing architecture node
prompt_patterns: should this have its own node
official page links to a component
rules.reusable_rule: Distinguish missing source vs missing relationship vs missing architecture node vs already-existing content, then apply the smallest necessary update.
rules.response_strategy: Search Records, Sources, Architecture References, and implicated official pages before creating anything new.

rules.title: Synchronization transparency
rules.reusable_rule: Distinguish actually executed externally, planned only, not yet written, and waiting for authorization.
rules.response_strategy: Do not imply external persistence without actual tool execution.

rules.title: Duplicate detection when record number is forgotten
prompt_patterns: not sure of the record number
rules.reusable_rule: Compare core propositions before creating a new record. If highly overlapping, preserve the canonical record.
rules.response_strategy: Create a duplicate relationship instead of incrementing a new ID.

rules.title: Assistant judgment as retrievable interaction data
rules.reusable_rule: Store shareable judgment summaries and retrieve similar interaction rules before deciding. Version on conflict instead of overwriting.
rules.response_strategy: Retrieve similar rules first; keep public de-identified summaries only.

rules.title: Automatic interaction retrieval and write gating
problem_types: interaction treated as a passive log
prompt_patterns: do not create an interaction for every event
rules.reusable_rule: Run the Trigger Router first. Retrieve similar rules before writing. Retrieval never creates a record. Prefer update/versioning over CREATE_NEW.
rules.response_strategy: Classify each meaningful event; leave Interaction Learning unchanged unless a reusable rule must be created, versioned, or reviewed.

rules.title: Structure-first user reasoning signal
prompt_patterns: these two things should stay separate
I don't know the database terms
rules.reusable_rule: Detect structural meaning before looking for technical vocabulary. Ordinary-language structure signals are retrieval triggers.
rules.response_strategy: Retrieve first from structural meaning. Retrieval does not persist. If a reusable rule changes, version additively.

rules.title: Proactive synthesis instead of toothpaste-style interaction
rules.reusable_rule: When a structural correction is detected, perform a local forward-scan before responding. Prefer one compact batch when confidence is sufficient. Bundle uncertain items as review candidates.
rules.response_strategy: Scan adjacent dependencies inside the current cluster. This is not next-question forecasting and is not a substitute for INT-0008 context escape.

rules.title: Structure-first retrieval and context escape
problem_types: user modeled only as a prompt sequence
proactive retrieval treated as next-question forecasting
prompt_patterns: not merely follow the conversation forward
do not model the user only as a sequence of prompts
retrieve from both internal and external
rules.reusable_rule: Do not model the user only as a sequence of prompts. Treat their behavior as a structure-first retrieval strategy. Retrieve INTERNAL and EXTERNAL sources symmetrically. When the local loop is repetitive or inefficient, stop extending it, search the relevant knowledge space, and return a consolidated structural answer. Retrieval is the escape from conversational recursion, not a forecast of the next question.
rules.response_strategy: Run context escape before another in-loop clarification. Search Interaction Learning, Records, Sources, Issues, Architecture References, repo files/history, and official/linked/authoritative external pages together. Persist only through the write gate.

versions.note: Canonical context-escape / dual-source retrieval rule. INT-0006 and INT-0007 remain distinct related layers.
